sources.note: Neutrik NE8MC-1 etherCON cable connector page (found by search; its drawing and DXF were not retrieved): zinc die-cast shell, boot for 3.5 - 8 mm cable, same RJ45 contact. The model is the RJ45 head of the rj45 spec (11.68 x 8 mm, 15 mm out of the shell) in a 22 mm round shell with a 26 mm body, a latch lever (26 x 30 x 70 mm overall): every size except the RJ45 head is an ESTIMATE. The catalog ethercon matesWith rj45.
